instruction: Review only the actual current workflow confirmation implementation: decision identity, continuation ownership, task cancellation and execution exclusivity. Return up to three concrete defects, each naming the exact source condition that demonstrates it. Return findings:[] if no concrete defect is found. The test harness explicitly adapts only old APIs for negative controls. Do not infer a UI caller, per-repo storage, completed Gitflow or benchmarks from these isolated tests. Do not propose generic risks unsupported by the supplied code. edits:[] required.
